articles.title: That Nail-Biting 'Brand New Day' Scene Was Lifted Straight from Spider-Man's Comic Book Death
articles.summary: A pivotal moment in 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' — where Peter Parker takes a sniper's bullet meant for Jean Grey — directly echoes his death in 'Ultimate Spider-Man.' But this time, Jean's powers and a quick hospital run keep him alive, leaving the door open for Miles Morales.

articles.title: Lollapalooza Night Two: Smashing Pumpkins' Nostalgia Meets Charli XCX's Cinematic Pop Spectacle
articles.summary: Despite steady rain, Lollapalooza's second night delivered unforgettable moments: Smashing Pumpkins brought out Yungblud and Olivia Rodrigo for surprise duets, while Charli XCX launched her 'Music, Fashion, Film' tour with a theatrical, freeze-frame finale.

articles.title: 1.37 Inches of Silver Foil May Upend Christianity's History in Europe
articles.summary: An 1,800-year-old amulet found in a Frankfurt grave contains a purely Christian inscription in Latin — the oldest evidence of the faith north of the Alps. It predates previous finds by 50–100 years, revealing that Christians lived there despite persecution.
